'''Passive Skills''' are attributes or natures that [[Pals]] can have. They can give various buffs/debuffs to the [[Character|Player]] or [[Pals|Pal]]. They are obtained randomly in the wild and can also be passed down through [[Breeding|breeding]]. A Pal can have up to four Passive Skills at a time, but it is not possible to have multiple copies of the same Passive Skill on one Pal. However, multiple Passive Skills that carry boosts or downgrades to the same stat will stack additively with each other. While most of the passive skills do exactly what they say they do, the ones affecting sale price have somewhat misleading descriptions: both price when selling ''and'' ''buying'' is affected, with Noble and Fine Furs affecting it favorably for the player (increasing the value when selling, and decreasing the value when purchasing), and Shabby affecting it unfavorably for the player (decreasing
